verdict.rationale: Docs and GitHub explicitly state 'first-class support for Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers' with a documented pattern to wrap an MCP server in an MCPToolset and pass it to the agent's tools parameter, described as one line of code integration. This is first-party documentation without independent hands-on verification of MCP-specific usage. Missing for 10: independent/community confirmation of MCP tool integration working end-to-end, and more detail on multi-server or auth configurations.
